hud.projecthero.shazam.title: SHAZAM!
projecthero.shazam.ability.word.desc: Type just the word in chat (any case, punctuation is fine). It isn't posted: magic lightning strikes you instead and everyone near sees "SHAZAM!". You transform, or turn back if you're transformed. The bolt deals 12 to creatures within 3 blocks (never you or your squadmates) and refills the Lightning bar. 4 seconds between words. You need your voice: not underwater without an air bubble, not inside powder snow.
projecthero.shazam.ability.flight.desc: Double-tap Space in the air while transformed to fly, again to drop. Fast (Sprint to go faster), and your cape streams behind you.
projecthero.shazam.ability.lightning_han: Lightning from your hand at what you look at (24 blocks): 9 damage, then it jumps to 2 nearby enemies. 8 lightning.
projecthero.shazam.ability.call_lightnin: A real lightning strike where you look, up to 64 blocks: 22 damage around it. It only sets fire if mob griefing is on. 30 lightning.
projecthero.shazam.ability.hercules_punc: 16 damage and the target flies about 15 blocks. It takes 8 more if it hits a wall. 10 lightning.
projecthero.shazam.ability.atlas_lift.de: Grab a creature in reach (even a huge one) and hold it overhead. Press again to hurl it where you look (thrown on its own after 4 seconds). It takes 10 when it lands or hits a wall. 15 lightning.
projecthero.shazam.ability.zeus_storm.de: For 5 seconds, lightning hits a random enemy within 16 blocks every half second, 10 damage each. 50 lightning, 15 s cooldown.
projecthero.shazam.ability.eternity_stri: Needs a full bar. You rise, the sky darkens, a huge bolt hits you, then you slam down: 50 damage to everything within 10 blocks. Empties the Lightning bar. 3 minute cooldown. Not for the Shazam Family.
A red blur 12 blocks along your look, with a crackle of lightning behind you. Free.
projecthero.shazam.ability.thunder_tackl: Fly-tackle the first creature in line up to 20 blocks away and drive it into the ground: 18 damage and a burst of lightning. 20 lightning (free, just a long dash, if nobody is in line).
projecthero.shazam.ability.thunderclap.d: Clap a shockwave in a cone in front of you: 12 damage and knockback. Breaks glass only if mob griefing is on. 15 lightning.
projecthero.shazam.ability.achilles_stan: For 4 seconds you take no damage, every enemy within 16 blocks comes for you (bosses too), and your squadmates near you take 30% less. 30 lightning, 30 s cooldown.
projecthero.shazam.ability.wisdom.desc: For 10 seconds you see every creature's health, armour and weakness above it, and the best tool or weapon for what you look at.
projecthero.shazam.ability.share_power.d: Aim at a squadmate: for 10 minutes they're in the Shazam Family and typing "Shazam" transforms them too (half your health and damage, same moves except Eternity Strike, gold trim on the suit). Up to 5 at once. 10 minute cooldown.
projecthero.guide.shazam.body: Say the magic word and lightning makes you the champion: S.H.A.Z.A.M. -- the Wisdom of Solomon, the Strength of Hercules, the Stamina of Atlas, the Power of Zeus, the Courage of Achilles and the Speed of Mercury.
projecthero.guide.shazam.getting.body: During a thunderstorm a very rare old man, Wizard Shazam, appears near villages. Right-click him and he judges whether you're pure of heart: no villager or iron golem killed in the last three days, and no villager nearby who dislikes you (the worthy and a Hero of the Village always pass). If you are, he gives you the power (it replaces your Primary power). If not, he fades in a flash of lightning and won't come back to you for 5 days. Random serums never give it.
projecthero.guide.shazam.word.body: Type "Shazam" in chat, nothing else. It isn't posted: lightning strikes you and you transform (the suit appears over your skin). Type it again to turn back. Each bolt deals 12 to creatures within 3 blocks (never you or squadmates) and refills your Lightning bar, so turning back and forth is a real trick, with 4 seconds between words. You can't say it underwater without an air bubble or inside powder snow.
projecthero.guide.shazam.traits.body: Only while transformed: 50 health, 35% less damage taken, no hunger drain, +10 melee damage, 40% faster, a little taller, and immune to fear (the Warden's darkness and other fear). Magic (potions, evokers, witches, Doctor Fate, Raven) hurts you 50% more.
projecthero.guide.shazam.lightning.body: Your moves cost lightning. Every transform bolt refills it, it fills during thunderstorms, and other lightning striking near you tops it up.
projecthero.guide.shazam.family.body: Share the Power (Shift+V) lets a squadmate say the word for 10 minutes. They get half your health and damage, the same moves except Eternity Strike, and gold trim on their suit. Up to 5 at once.
projecthero.guide.shazam.commands.body: Operators: /projecthero power grant shazam, /projecthero power tune shazam lightning <0-100> | cooldowns | word | wizard | pure.
